# Psalm 65 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David. A-song.

**2** To-You silence [is] praise, O-God, in-Zion, and-to-You a-vow is-paid.

**3** O-Hearer of-prayer, to-You all flesh comes.

**4** Matters of-iniquity are-too-strong for-me; our-transgressions — You atone-for-them.

**5** Blessed [is the one whom] You-choose and-bring-near [to] dwell in-Your-courts. We-are-satisfied with-the-goodness of-Your-house, Your-holy temple.

**6** With-awesome-deeds in-righteousness You-answer-us, O-God of-our-salvation, the-trust of-all the-ends of-the-earth and-the-farthest sea;

**7** the-One-establishing mountains by-His-strength, [who is] girded with-might;

**8** the-One-stilling the-roar of-the-seas, the-roar of-their-waves, and-the-tumult of-the-peoples.

**9** And-those-dwelling at-the-ends [of the earth] fear at-Your-signs; the-goings-forth of-morning and-evening You-cause-to-sing-for-joy.

**10** You-visit the-earth and-water-it abundantly; You-greatly-enrich-it. The-stream of-God [is] full of-water; You-prepare their-grain, for so You-prepare-it.

**11** Its-furrows You-drench abundantly; You-settle its-ridges; with-showers You-soften-it; its-growth You-bless.

**12** You-crown the-year of-Your-goodness, and-Your-tracks drip-with abundance.

**13** The-pastures of-the-wilderness drip, and-the-hills gird [themselves with] joy.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **65:12**: 'Your tracks drip with abundance' — God's wagon tracks overflow with fatness. Wherever God has passed, fertility follows.

— EMET
